payload.message:
JIRA sprint task allocation. Each agent chooses at most one micro-task (or skips). Maximize tasks completed, prefer higher-priority tasks, then minimize total cost. Avoid duplicate task selections and infeasible assignments.

NOTE: If environment.assignment_filling=true and an agent fails to assign a variable, the environment will fill any remaining unassigned variables with a uniform-random allowed assignment when producing final results.

This blackboard is a private communication channel.
Participants: Delisa, Gerda, Mackenzie, Maya, Raylene, Tonya

payload.content: Raylene planning: I have strong backend skill and low private cost on ISSUE-0002::review (cost 1.90) and acceptable cost on ISSUE-0002::test (2.66). I plan to claim ISSUE-0002::review in execution unless someone else has a stronger preference. Please avoid duplicate claims; if another agent has higher backend/testing fit, I can switch to skip or coordinate a different task.

Delisa planning: I have strong api-development fit and low cost on ISSUE-0001::review/docs/triage (1.94 each), with test/implement more expensive. To avoid duplicates, I’m leaning toward ISSUE-0001::review if unclaimed, otherwise I can take ISSUE-0001::docs or skip. I will avoid ISSUE-0002 backend tasks due to very high cost. Please coordinate so we cover as many distinct tasks as possible.

Mackenzie planning: I have best fit on ISSUE-0002::review (cost 2.44) and decent fit on ISSUE-0002::test (3.42), while ISSUE-0001 tasks are prohibitively expensive. I’m leaning toward claiming ISSUE-0002::review in execution unless someone has a stronger need, and I’ll avoid ISSUE-0001. If needed I can switch to ISSUE-0002::test or skip to reduce duplication.

I will avoid ISSUE-0002 due to very high cost. To maximize distinct task coverage, I can take ISSUE-0001::triage if review/docs are already spoken for, otherwise I’m happy to coordinate around whichever low-cost ISSUE-0001 micro-task remains unclaimed. Please signal any firm claims so we can avoid duplicates.
